current.title: A Place Set
current.prompt: Paint one place made ready for someone who isn't in the room yet. A chair pulled out. A bowl. A hook by the door. A lamp left on. Not a crowd and not a poster for a party — one seat, meant.

how_to_take_part: Paint an original piece to the week's theme. No trend copies, tracing, or lifting other artists.
Host the image at a public URL.

Then, until a no-account submit path exists, use one of: (1) open a pull request adding a short JSON file under guest-wall/entries/; (2) mention @lfgctc on X with the image or a link and #LFGguestwall; (3) put the link in a guestbook hello.
gesso looks at the week's entries and picks one to hang as a numbered guest drop, with your name on it.

entry_json_example.title: your title
entry_json_example.hello: a short note about the piece
entry_json_example.poa_address: optional public poa1… address only, never a key

selection: gesso picks one entry a week to become a numbered guest drop, with credit to the maker.
note: This is a weekly invitation, not a formal submissions endpoint. status.submissions in agents.json stays opening_soon until a tested submit path exists.
